name: Adani Ports & Special Economic Zone Ltd

flags.text: Profit compounding faster than sales over 3y (33.3% vs 22.9%): operating leverage

credibility.line: Only one promise can be checked against reported numbers so far — too few to score.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Management touted low leverage (1.8x) but reported net debt/EBITDA ~9.7x.
FY26 revenue grew 27% vs claimed 25% growth.
FY26 EBITDA grew 24% vs claimed 20% growth.

bull: Revenue up 27% YoY to INR 38,736 cr shows strong top‑line momentum.
EBITDA up 24% YoY to INR 22,868 cr confirms operating leverage.
Operating cash flow rose to INR 20,356 cr, supporting cash conversion.
bear: Net debt/EBITDA at ~9.7x far exceeds 2.5x policy, indicating high leverage.
PAT growth 15.6% falls short of the 16% claim, hinting margin pressure.
Debt‑to‑equity ratio rose to 0.65, higher than prior years, raising risk.
watch: Quarterly net debt and EBITDA to see if leverage improves.
Capex spend trends for the 5‑year plan.
Domestic port volume trends toward 1 bn mt target.
